title: Build SettingsPage with tab navigation and UsersTab
description:
SettingsPage only renders SystemHealthTab. It needs a full tab interface with user management.

**Implementation:**
- Add tab navigation bar: System Health, Users, API Info
- System Health tab: already exists (`SystemHealthTab`)
- Users tab: wire existing `UsersTab` component from `components/settings/`
  - If UsersTab is stubbed, build it: list users from `GET /api/v1/users`, show username/email/role/status, add Create User button using `handleCreateUser` endpoint
- API Info tab: show current API key info (masked), API URL, version from status endpoint
- Use consistent tab styling matching PolicyPage tab pattern

**Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx`, `dashboard/src/components/settings/UsersTab.tsx`
definitionOfDone: Tab navigation with at least 3 tabs

Users tab shows user list with create action
